General.Name: MAS Financial Services Limited
General.Description: MAS Financial Services Limited, a non-banking finance company, provides retail financing services in India. The company offers micro-enterprises, small and medium businesses, two-wheeler, commercial vehicle, used vehicle loans, and salaried personal loans, tractor, and housing loans. It serves through a distribution network of partner microfinance institutions, non-banking finance companies, housing finance companies, and franchisees. MAS Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
